description: Combination semantics of the decision profile v1alpha1 (docs/contracts/module-contract-v0.1.md, section 6). Each case is one bundle for agent_id holding the listed policies, one AuthZEN request and the expected response. The response carries bundle_version, the version of the case's bundle, with policy.permit, policy.forbid, policy.no_permit and error.evaluation, and may carry it or not with error.unknown_agent and error.invalid_request (section 6.6). valid says whether the policy passes the validator against the profile's Cedar schema, extended with tool_args_extension. A request that a case refuses with error.invalid_request does not match decision-request.schema.json, unless the case's rule names the rule of the profile, outside the schema, that refuses it: another_agent, an agent action that names another agent (section 6.3); not_an_integer, an argument that is not a signed 64-bit integer written without a fraction or an exponent (section 6.4); or invalid_time, a time that does not exist (section 1).
tool_args_extension: type ToolArgs = { recipient_domain?: String, amount?: Long };

cases.description: Conditions on labels, which are entity tags

policies.text:

when { principal.hasTag("team") && principal.getTag("team") == "finance" };
